source_policy.syllabus: Objective locators are copied from the approved P4R-1 lesson source map, which preserves reviewed Stage 3 source locators.
source_policy.coursebook: Book section, chapter, printed page, PDF page and relationship are copied from the approved P4R-1 mappings for each Stage 3 KnowledgeUnit.
source_policy.authority: Explanations, examples, self-checks and rules are labelled AlgoCore-authored; no Cambridge mark is inferred.

line_binding_basis.validation: Every KnowledgeUnit binding equals its frozen role-map entry; every line ID exists in the correct current artifact.json and the trimmed bound line text equals matched_text. Artifact ID, lesson ID and production-v1 version must match.

bilingual_remediation.semantic_basis: Both locales now use the same unit title, per-unit invariant, artifact ID, bound line IDs, matched code text, fixture ID and exact fixture input.
bilingual_remediation.terminology: Vietnamese uses cây nhị phân, danh sách liên kết and tệp truy cập ngẫu nhiên wherever the English peer uses binary tree, linked list or random file.
bilingual_remediation.token_and_constraint_policy: Stable technical tokens and numeric constraints are mirrored across each bilingual pair.
